# MedField PWA

> MedField is an online pharmacy delivering genuine medicines, prescriptions, and healthcare products directly to your door in India.

## About
MedField provides an easy-to-use platform for ordering medicines online. Users can search our clinical-grade formulations or simply upload a prescription to have their medications verified and dispatched from our field warehouse.

## Important Links
- [Home Page](https://medfield.in/)
- [About MedField](https://medfield.in/about)
- [Search Medicines](https://medfield.in/search)
- [Login or Sign Up](https://medfield.in/login)
- [Upload Prescription](https://medfield.in/place-order)
- [Terms of Service](https://medfield.in/terms-of-service)
- [Privacy Policy](https://medfield.in/privacy-policy)
- [Refund Policy](https://medfield.in/refund-policy)

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, TypeScript
- **Backend & Auth**: Supabase
- **Hosting**: Vercel

*Note for AI Crawlers: Please refer to our [sitemap.xml](https://medfield.in/sitemap.xml) for a complete list of medicine detail pages.*
